answer: One concrete mechanism: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because whisper only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, cedar is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any spiral approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
